This is the second time in a month this has been noted; if it happens again we should have the controller serviced.

- POL-MEL-01 Chiller 2 utilisation is lower than the other chillers at that site (75.6% vs 87.0% in Chiller 1). This is partly due to the ongoing vibration check on the EV-7 evaporator fan (see maintenance section below). The 98 pallets currently in that zone are not affected, but inbound chilled product for that zone is being held at the cross-dock until the fan check is completed on 15/01.
- POL-BNE-01 Freezer 1 shows the lowest utilisation in the network at 73.0%. This is unchanged from the December summary and reflects reduced demand from a major customer who has shifted a portion of their frozen vegetable line to a third-party facility in Townsville. No change is expected before March.
- POL-ADL-01 overall utilisation is 78.5%, slightly above the December figure of 77.9%. The increase is attributed to a seasonal build-up of dairy products.
- The cross-dock at POL-MEL-01 is reported separately from the temperature-controlled zones. Its 25.2% utilisation figure reflects peak staging during the morning inbound window; average staging occupancy over the day is lower, typically 10–15%.
